panels.title: Pipeline Status
panels.description: Current status of each pipeline's latest run

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.name AS pipeline, pr.run_id, pr.status, pr.started_at, pr.ended_at, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (pr.ended_at - pr.started_at))::int AS duration_seconds, pr.source_row_count, pr.target_row_count, pr.failure_reason FROM pipeline_runs pr JOIN pipelines p ON p.id = pr.pipeline_id WHERE pr.id IN (SELECT MAX(id) FROM pipeline_runs GROUP BY pipeline_id) ORDER BY p.name;

SELECT pr.started_at AS time, p.name AS pipeline, CASE WHEN pr.status = 'passed' THEN 0 WHEN pr.status = 'late' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS status_code, pr.status FROM pipeline_runs pr JOIN pipelines p ON p.id = pr.pipeline_id ORDER BY pr.started_at;

panels.title: Freshness: Age vs Threshold
panels.description: Shows how old the latest data is compared to the freshness threshold

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT pipeline_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM pipeline_runs GROUP BY pipeline_id) SELECT p.name AS pipeline, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - pr.ended_at)) / 3600.0 AS age_hours FROM pipeline_runs pr JOIN pipelines p ON p.id = pr.pipeline_id JOIN latest l ON l.max_id = pr.id ORDER BY age_hours DESC;

panels.title: Row Counts: Source vs Target
panels.description: Source and target row counts from the latest run of each pipeline

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT pipeline_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM pipeline_runs GROUP BY pipeline_id) SELECT p.name AS pipeline, pr.source_row_count AS source, pr.target_row_count AS target FROM pipeline_runs pr JOIN pipelines p ON p.id = pr.pipeline_id JOIN latest l ON l.max_id = pr.id ORDER BY p.name;

panels.title: Failed Checks by Type
panels.description: Count of failed checks grouped by check type

targets.rawSql: SELECT cr.check_type AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM check_results cr WHERE cr.status = 'failed' GROUP BY cr.check_type ORDER BY value DESC;

panels.title: Open Incidents
panels.description: Currently open incidents by owner and severity

targets.rawSql: SELECT i.id, p.name AS pipeline, pr.run_id, i.incident_type, i.severity, i.owner, i.retryable, i.failure_summary, i.first_observed_at FROM incidents i JOIN pipeline_runs pr ON pr.id = i.pipeline_run_id JOIN pipelines p ON p.id = pr.pipeline_id WHERE i.status = 'open' ORDER BY i.first_observed_at DESC;

panels.title: Recent Schema Drift Events
panels.description: Schema compatibility failures in the last 30 days

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.name AS pipeline, pr.run_id, cr.check_type, cr.message, cr.expected, cr.observed, pr.started_at FROM check_results cr JOIN pipeline_runs pr ON pr.id = cr.pipeline_run_id JOIN pipelines p ON p.id = pr.pipeline_id WHERE cr.check_type IN ('schema_compatibility', 'target_schema_compatibility') AND cr.status = 'failed' ORDER BY pr.started_at DESC LIMIT 50;
